messages:
lee: FYI getting 3 customer escalations for Monsoon (new model onboarding). p99 for long-context requests spiked ~4x after the tokenizer tweak rolled yesterday. customers seeing timeouts and billing anomalies.

mike: I see the spike on infra dashboards too. p95 up modestly but p99 jumps around 2.2s -> 8.9s on 8k token inputs. any quick repro?

ingrid: suspect the subtoken merge change we shipped. Monsoon has a lot of long-concat examples; we may be causing KV fragmentation and extra cache lookup loops.

lee: attaching a minimal repro from customer A (anonymized):
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model":"monsoon-v1", "input":"<8k-long-text>" }
```
They report success on monsoon-v1-legacy and no spike on other models.

juan: ops-bot shows a cascade of retries from stream-gateway at 2026-03-15T09:12:xxZ. logs: `kvcache: miss_depth=14 loop=3` then `rpc.wait 250ms` repeated.

ops-bot: deploy-bot triggered rollback job 5078899001 for tokenizer-change on canary yesterday at 03:45, but it looks like the change promoted to stable at 05:10.

mike: can someone dump a KV cache trace for a single slow request? I want to see per-layer entries and whether we are recomputing offsets.

ingrid: grabbing a trace from a repro run now. snippet: 
```
[TRACE] request_id=abc123 model=monsoon-v1 seq_len=8200
kv_index=0 hit:false
kv_index=1 hit:false
kv_index=2 hit:false
... kv_index=14 hit:false
loop_count=3 total_kv_reads=45
compute_time_tokens=920ms kv_overhead=4.9s
```
This matches customer timing.

lee: customers are asking about refunds for extra billing due to retries/timeouts. sarah can you advise?

sarah: I'm collating impacted invoices. We'll hold billing for obvious error cases and flag credits. Need an estimated time-to-fix to communicate.

juan: mitigations in the short term: 1) Route Monsoon long-context requests to monsoon-v1-legacy by default via a routing rule for requests > 4k tokens. 2) Apply a rate-limit bump for affected customers to avoid retries. 3) Hotfix to bypass the new subtoken path for monsoon only.

mike: I can push a routing rule now and enable fallback to legacy. Hotfix for bypassing subtoken path requires a rebuild but I can patch the config to force legacy tokenizer for monsoon in the runtime; that is low-risk.

ingrid: also recommend we disable the new merge heuristic globally for canary->stable until we confirm no regression for long contexts.

lee: agreed. mike, please do routing and runtime config patch. juan, please add rollback of tokenizer-change to the action list. sarah, I'll send a standard customer comms draft once we have timing.

mike: routing rule applied: monsoon long-requests -> monsoon-v1-legacy (rule id r-50789-L). runtime config patched to force legacy tokenizer for monsoon (patched at 09:45 UTC).

deploy-bot: rollout status: routing rule r-50789-L active on 6 regions, config patch deployed to 4/4 runtime clusters.

mike: after routing patch p99 dropped from 8.9s -> 1.1s for the repro workload. KV miss loop count fell to 1-2. metrics backfilling looks good.

lee: excellent. ingrid, can you run a deeper failure-mode test and a small ablation of the merge heuristic to reproduce and root cause? aim to have a PR by EOD with test harness.

ingrid: on it. I'll also run targeted fuzzing for subtokens in monsoon and run long-seq unit tests.

juan: keeping incident open until we validate for 24h and confirm no billing surprises. logged as INC-2026-0315-MONSOON.

lee: customer comms draft: "We identified a tokenizer merge change that caused increased latency on a small set of long-context Monsoon requests. We have routed long inputs to the legacy tokenizer and applied a runtime patch while we investigate. No data exposure. We will issue credits where applicable." please review before I send.

sarah: good to send once you add the estimated 24-48h remediation window. I'll prepare credits template.

mike: final note for postmortem: include kernel selection and kvcache hit distribution. this looks like a regression interaction between token merge boundaries and our KV indexing logic.

lee: thanks all. keeping thread updates here. I'll post a short postmortem stub after 24h with timeline and next steps.
